newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline drifts quietly alongside NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline drifts quietly alongside NYMEX.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices drifted lazily sideways on Thursday while NYMEX unleaded gasoline futures failed to move far in either direction, traders said.
One Regular barge was heard traded a little weaker at $199 fob ARA but prompt Eurograde barges were stable at $209.
Cargoes remained relatively tight in the prompt period and demand was lacklustre, although growing interest in March barrels was likely to boost prices, traders said.
Latest data from the Americal Petroluem Institute showed a 5.1 percent monthly rise at the end of January. But the data also showed a year-on-year fall of 4.3 percent.
